final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS film_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.film_count) AS total_films, AVG(rc.film_count - ra.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.film_count > ra.avg_count
